Step 4/0 — WHAT: and the consumer ends on the right number
`final` = 19 after `count` = 11 published values: 8, -8, 15, -15, 15, -15, 15, -15, 15, -15, 19. All four answers were needed to get here: WHERE picked the 4 events,
WHAT summed them, WHEN decided that 8 goes out first and that id 7 is still admissible, and HOW made every correction safe for a sink that can only add.
